Contract ManageStoreCRUDService::modifyStore(id:Integer,name:String,address:String,isopened:Boolean): Boolean {
          definition:
          store:Store = Store.allInstance()->any(s | s.Id = id)
            
            precondition:
          Store.allInstance()->includes(store) and store.Id = id
            
            postcondition:
          let storeExists:Boolean in store.oclIsUndefined() = false implies (store.Name = name and store.Address = address and store.IsOpened = isopened) and result = storeExists
            
        }
